I've upgraded Crônicas do Abismo into a more challenging, Megabonk-inspired survival RPG while preserving your existing game.

Playable version

Download the game — Single HTML file

What's new

  • Elemental combat: Fire burns, ice freezes, lightning stuns and chains, nature poisons, and arcane attacks increase vulnerability. Enemies have elemental resistances.

  • Harder waves: Every 38 seconds, enemy health, damage, speed, numbers, and elite encounters increase.

  • Infinite world: Procedurally generated regions with forests, frozen lands, deserts, swamps, ruins, camps, and travelers.

  • Smarter enemies: Different enemies flank, retreat, chase, attack from range, or heal allies. They also have contextual speech bubbles.

  • More enemies: Spiders, wraiths, cultists, rune guardians, shamans, harpies, and mimics.

  • Improved character: Smoother walking animation, Tiefling and Minotaur races, hairstyles, scars, emblems, armor details, and body types.

  • More RPG progression: Collectible XP gems, randomized upgrades, equipment synergies, merchants, healers, blacksmiths, and other NPCs.

  • Automatic combat: Optional auto-attack mode, toggled with T.

I tested loading, combat effects, NPC trading, procedural generation, wave progression, and the playable HTML in Chromium without JavaScript errors.

To play: Open the single HTML file in your browser. To integrate the changes into your original project, use the ZIP and keep its folder structure.

One distinction: enemy dialogue uses local behavioral AI and contextual scripted lines, not an external conversational AI service. Also, your original optional assets images weren't included in the uploads; you can add that folder back for the original artwork.
